title: Documentation-only handoff and review smoke test
question: Can a fresh session use only repository files to select a hypothesis, produce a bounded handoff and record a review without the original conversation?
protocol_steps: Select H-HARNESS-001 and read the harness README/protocol only.
Assign a documentation-only task to the lead and a claim-only review to the critical reviewer.
Record the handoff and the reviewer verdict in this directory.
Validate the record and update the research state index.

review.notes: The reviewer checked the handoff and validator behavior, but this is not independent verification.

outcome: accept-with-limits: the protocol is usable without a transcript, but it has not been tested on a real R1 campaign or by an independent agent.
limitations: No compiler was built and no code was executed.
No runtime, IR, assembly or mathematical evidence is present.
The author and reviewer are the same model; this is a smoke test only.
next_action: Use the harness for R1-A and record real handoff friction; request an independent or human review before promoting the protocol claim.
